pages.alt: George finds a little dragon in the grass

lines.text: One sunny morning, George was walking near the tall grass by the hill.
Suddenly, something moved. George stopped and looked carefully.
A little green dragon was sitting quietly in the grass.
The dragon was small and bright green, with tiny wings on his back.
His eyes were kind, and he did not look scary at all.
George smiled, because he had never met a dragon before.

pages.alt: George says hello to the dragon

lines.text: George took a small step closer and spoke softly.
Hello. Who are you?
I am Pip. I am a little dragon, and I am lost.
Don't worry, Pip. I can help you.
Pip smiled and sat on a warm rock in the sunshine.
Can you help me find my home? It is near a big cave.
Yes! I know that hill. We can go there together.

pages.alt: George and Pip walk up the hill

lines.text: George and Pip walked side by side up the green hill.
Is your home at the top?
Yes. My family lives in the cave beyond the path.
The wind was cool, but the two new friends felt brave.
At the top of the hill, they saw a big, friendly cave.
Is this your home, Pip?
I think so! Come with me. I want to show you something.

pages.alt: They find a shining red egg

lines.text: Inside the cave, something began to shine in the soft light.
Look! A red egg!
That is my sister's egg. She will hatch soon!
George laughed with joy. The egg glowed like a tiny lantern.

pages.alt: George and Pip celebrate as friends

lines.text: George and Pip were very happy outside the cave.
Thank you, George. You are a true friend.
I am glad I found you, Pip. Let's play again tomorrow!
And from that day, George and the little dragon were friends forever.

quiz.q: Why does Pip need George's help?

options: In a cave beyond the path

quiz.q: What do they find shining in the cave?
What does Pip call George at the end?
